<thought>Using the observed monoisotopic m/z 182.073165 and the isotopic pattern, the molecular formula is C13H10O. The structure that fits this formula and is a common aromatic ketone is benzophenone, whose SMILES is O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2</final_answer>
